name: Leeford Ketofly Soap 75g Ketoconazole & Cetrimide Anti Fungal Medicated Soap
description:
Leeford Ketofly Soap 75g – Ketoconazole & Cetrimide Anti-Fungal Medicated Soap

Effective Anti-Fungal Treatment for Skin Infections

Product Type: Medicated Soap
Weight: 75g
Active Ingredients: Ketoconazole, Cetrimide

Key Benefits:

Treats Fungal Infections: Effective against athlete’s foot, ringworm, thrush, and other skin fungal infections.

Kills Fungus: Targets and eliminates the fungus that causes skin infections.

Gentle Cleansing: Helps maintain skin hygiene while treating infections.

Prevents Recurrence: Reduces the risk of fungal infections when used as prescribed.

Usage Instructions:

Use as prescribed by your doctor.

Regular use is necessary for maximum benefit.

Skin infections usually improve within 2–4 weeks.

Wash clothing and socks thoroughly if treating athlete’s foot, and change shoes daily.

Avoid direct contact with eyes. Rinse immediately with water if contact occurs and seek medical advice.

Precautions & Side Effects:

Common side effects may include burning, irritation, itching, redness, dryness, peeling, or blistering.

Rarely, it may cause hair thinning.

Severe allergic reactions are rare but may occur. Seek emergency help if there is rash, swelling of lips, face or throat, or breathing difficulties.

✅ Best For: Fungal skin infections like athlete’s foot, ringworm, and thrush
✅ Safe Use: Follow doctor’s dosage and duration for effective results
